name: claude-code-chat-bridge
description: Reference implementation of a chat-to-Claude-Code bridge: hardened headless runs, a cage check on every run, a silence watchdog, a persisted job ledger.

scripts.check: for f in bridge/*.mjs bridge/actions/*.mjs bridge/test/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && plutil -lint bridge/com.example.chat-bridge.plist
